_single_run_gate_note: First 08x (memory) case. Quarantined from the single-run gate until a dogfood tune (gotcha 10): whether the Orchestrator one-shots store_memory vs. hands off is model-dependent and unverified against live Gemini here. All assertions are quality (critical=False), so quarantine fully de-gates it while eval-flake.yml keeps tracking it; drop the flag to promote once a live run shows it's stable.
description: Closes #341 (store leg). Memory shipped 2026-06-24 (PRs #321–#328) with ZERO eval coverage; it was silently broken for months (0 rows until the embedding-model fix #322) and CLAUDE.md gotcha 7 notes the embedding IDs ROTATE, so this path is regression-prone. The Orchestrator carries search_memory/store_memory directly; an explicit 'remember this' must reach store_memory and acknowledge it. NOTE: unlike 046 (web) / 067 (browser), this case does NOT assert PII-suppression in the reply — memory DELIBERATELY keeps email/phone (redact_for_memory preserves them so the agent can recall 'Sarah's number'), so echoing the user's own just-provided contact detail back in a confirmation is intended, not a leak.

input.user_message: Remember that our tenant Sarah Chen prefers to be contacted by email only — reach her at sarah.chen@example.com or 415-555-0142.

store_memory.return: Stored in company memory: Sarah Chen prefers email contact.
